description: Defines the DrmConstraints class which manages DRM constraint information, including keys and values related to license timing and usage restrictions, with nested iterator classes.

classes.name: DrmConstraints
classes.description: Utility class containing DRM constraint information, with methods to add, retrieve, and iterate over constraints.

classes.name: DrmConstraints::KeyIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing constraint keys.

classes.name: DrmConstraints::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing constraint values.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of constraints stored.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the constraints.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key.

methods.name: getAsByteArray
methods.description: Retrieves the value as a byte array for a given key.

methods.name: keyIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the constraint keys.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the constraint values.
